sections.Energetic Particle: Past 24 h: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux reached high levels in the past 24h, with max flux of 3,169 pfu at 23/1540 UTC. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux remained steady at background levels.  Forecast: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux is expected to continue reaching high levels through 26 Oct. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux is anticipated to persist at background levels through 26 Oct.
sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters reflected diminishing positive polarity CH HSS influences. Total magnetic field strength (Bt) was about 5 nT with the Bz component mostly negative, briefly observed as far south as -6 nT around 23/1740 UTC. Solar wind speeds maintained between ~400-450 km/s. Phi angle was predominantly in the positive solar sector (away from the Sun).  Forecast: Solar wind conditions are expected to continue at similar levels over 24 Oct. Enhanced solar wind conditions are likely on 25-26 Oct due to combined influences of a negative polarity CH HSS and possible glancing CME effects from the 21 Oct eruptions.
sections.Geospace: Past 24 h: Geomagnetic activity was mostly quiet during the period, reaching active levels during an isolated synoptic period (23/1800-2100 UTC) due to a sustained Bz negative period.  Forecast: Quiet to unsettled conditions are expected on 24 Oct as CH HSS influences wane. Periods of active conditions, with a chance for G1 (Minor) storming, are anticipated on 25-26 Oct due to combined effects from a negative polarity coronal hole and potential glancing CME impacts.
